tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand deep violet. Filled buttons, active nav item, selected tab indicator, focused field border, switches on, links, the "Toolbox" of the wordmark, the chatbot brace box. Text on it: on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Soft violet tint: FAB, selected chips, highlighted rows. Text on it: on-primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Violet-grey. Secondary icons and text accents; rarely a fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Violet-grey tint, the workhorse tonal fill: tonal buttons, filter chips, nav-rail active pill, segmented button selected, env badges, avatar backgrounds.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Green signal colour: the play icon of Run actions (as run-icon on the night button, as tertiary in text buttons), the working dots of a running command, deploy states. Light is deep green tone 30 (#005232, 8.9:1 on surface); dark is the neon (tone 85). Never a button fill.

tokens.name: run
tokens.usage: The Run action (Run, Deploy, Apply, New run): the night “terminal” button of the logo — night in light, inverted to the pale on-surface tone in dark. One filled Run per screen.

tokens.name: on-run
tokens.usage: Label of the Run button (19.5 : 1 light, 15.1 : 1 dark).

tokens.name: run-icon
tokens.usage: The play icon on the Run button: the neon cursor of the logo on the night button, emerald on the pale one.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: 'Deploying…' chips, small green FAB, the cursor in the logo (neon on light, deep green on dark).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error role. Error outlines, ERR log level, destructive text buttons, error text. Light is tone 30 (#93000A, 8.9:1 on surface) so error text clears 7:1; dark stays tone 80.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: the page surface is near-neutral (chroma 4); the containers (dialogs, menus, pickers, panels) are a light purple one step lighter than MD3 (chroma 10, tones 97/96/94/92); the navigation is the deepest violet band (nav-container).

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on any surface tone.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Legacy variant surface; prefer the surface-container scale.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, captions, inactive icons. 8.9:1 on surface in light, 10.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: nav-container
tokens.usage: Navigation frame only: top app bar, drawer, rail, bottom navigation bar, bottom app bar — header and drawer share it so they read as one frame. The deepest light surface: a violet band (night hue, chroma 20, tone 92 = #EDE4FF), darker than the pale containers; night tone 10 in dark. Active item and chips on it: nav-active.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Active item indicator on nav-container (drawer pill, rail and bar indicators): secondary tone 85 in light so it stands out on the violet band; secondary-container in dark. Text and icon on it: on-secondary-container.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Default container: app bar, panels, list zebra.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Filled text fields, highest tonal step.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons and chips, text-field resting border.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Snackbar action text. Dark is tone 30 (#413C8A, 7.2:1 on the pale inverse surface).

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow colour for the elevation tokens.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Light teal (tone 80) in both themes, extended colour: AI-powered features (suggestions, explain/generate, AI chips) and the brand's AI badge on the mark. Only `ai-container` changes between themes. Never chrome, navigation or non-AI buttons.

tokens.name: on-ai
tokens.usage: Text on ai, including the “AI” of the badge.

tokens.name: ai-container
tokens.usage: AI suggestion cards and AI chips.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus indicator: a 2 px ring with a 2 px gap around buttons, chips, icon buttons, navigation items, tabs, list rows and cards (10.7:1 on surface in light, 10.9:1 in dark; the gap keeps it on the page colour even around the night Run button). Text fields, selects and text areas take no ring: their border turns 2 px primary.

tokens.name: ai-strong
tokens.usage: AI marks drawn as lines or dots on light grounds: working dots, pen orbit, guide track, the AI spark icon (teal tone 40, 6.1:1 on surface). In dark it equals ai. Fills (badge, chips) keep ai / ai-container.

tokens.name: logo-box
tokens.usage: The logo family only: the toolbox box and handle of the mark, the favicon tile, the app-icon tile, the brand loader and the state marks. Night (#0D0B14, the seed itself) on light backgrounds, lavender (primary) on dark. Never a UI surface.

tokens.name: on-logo-box
tokens.usage: The > chevron of the prompt on logo-box.

tokens.name: logo-cursor
tokens.usage: The cursor of the prompt on logo-box: full neon on the night box, emerald on the lavender box.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy / passing. Status dots, INFO log level. Status is never told by colour alone: success, warning and error share a lightness, so they always come with a glyph and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Degraded / attention. WARN log level. Always with a glyph and a word.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Each tool runs in an isolated workspace and reports back to the run log.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.sample: Each tool runs in an isolated workspace and reports back to the run log.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Each tool runs in an isolated workspace and reports back to the run log.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Metadata: IDs, paths, timestamps, log levels (Open Sans, 600 for emphasis).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminal output, keys, URLs, connection strings — Open Sans at 600 so data stands apart from prose.

spacing.note: 4 px grid. Component insets use 2–6; section rhythm uses 6–12.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding, card padding, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, filled-button horizontal padding, section gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Side gutters of long-form reading pages at Large and up (app pages use the layout-margin-* of their window class).

breakpoint.note: Material 3 window size classes. A breakpoint is the lower bound of a class (window width, px): compact < 600 ≤ medium < 840 ≤ expanded < 1200 ≤ large < 1600 ≤ extra-large. Shell follows the window; page content follows the page area (.ait-page container).

tokens.name: breakpoint-medium
tokens.usage: Medium: 600–839 px, tablets in portrait, foldables, narrow windows.

tokens.name: breakpoint-expanded
tokens.usage: Expanded: 840–1199 px, tablets in landscape, small laptops, half a desktop screen.

tokens.name: breakpoint-large
tokens.usage: Large: 1200–1599 px, laptops and desktops — the reference mockups are 1440 × 900.

layout.note: Page margins, grid columns and gutters per window class; content widths. CSS: --ait-page-margin, --ait-grid-columns, --ait-grid-gutter switch at the breakpoints.

tokens.name: layout-navigation-rail
tokens.usage: NavigationRail width, Medium and Expanded (and the folded drawer).

tokens.name: layout-navigation-drawer
tokens.usage: Standard NavigationDrawer width, Large and Extra-large.

tokens.name: layout-assistant-width
tokens.usage: Docked assistant default width (320 – min(640 px, 50 %)), Large and up.

tokens.name: layout-page-min-with-assistant
tokens.usage: The page keeps at least this width beside the docked assistant; the drawer folds to the rail to make room.

tokens.name: layout-side-column
tokens.usage: Side column beside the table when the page area is ≥ 1040 px (400 px from 1380 px).

tokens.name: layout-reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a text column (docs, settings, policies).

tokens.name: layout-form-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a single-column form.

tokens.name: layout-short-height
tokens.usage: Under this window height (phone in landscape): rail instead of bar, full-screen dialogs.

radius.note: Material 3 shape scale with a 16 px ceiling: Large is the largest corner on any rectangle; full is reserved for circles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The ceiling of the scale: buttons, segmented buttons, search bars, navigation items (hover and active), dialogs, sheets, pickers, large FAB, large panels. The logo box corner (10/64 of the mark).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Pinned to radius-lg — nothing in the system is rounder than 16 px except circles. Kept for Material naming (corner-extra-large).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles only: avatars, badges, radio, switch, icon-button state layers, dots. Never on buttons, pills, search bars or navigation items.

shadow.note: Tonal surface containers first; shadows only where the MD3 spec asks.

meta.scheme: Tonal Spot palettes from the seeds #1E1B4B (primary deep violet, hue 288 c46; secondary on the same hue c24), #00F5A0 (tertiary neon green, hue 161 c71) and #0D0B14 (night neutrals, hue 296 c12). Light: primary tone 25, tertiary tone 40, containers 90, on-container text tone 10, outlines 45/75. Dark ("night"): primary tone 80, tertiary tone 85 (the neon), surface tone 6 with containers 4–22. Logo family on a night box (#0D0B14): logo-box / on-logo-box / logo-cursor. Shape ceiling 16 px. v4.2: light surfaces near-neutral (chroma 4, MD3 container steps 96/94/92/90); nav-container keeps the violet tint. v4.3: light containers back to light purple (chroma 12, MD3 steps 96/94/92/90); page surface and cards stay near-neutral. v4.4: light containers one step lighter (chroma 10, 97/96/94/92); nav-container deeper (chroma 20, tone 92) with nav-active for the active item. v4.5: the top app bar joins the drawer on nav-container.
meta.fonts: BNPP Type (UI: display, headline, title, label) as a file, weight 500; Open Sans (body, code and identifiers) from Google Fonts. No monospace face.
